messages:
Maria: Heads-up — we need to align API status codes with console phrasing before next rollout. Too many places showing different messages.
Ajay: Agree. Where is the most inconsistent spot? client-facing 429/5xx and our 'degraded' badges?
Sam: Mostly 429 variants and runtime fallbacks. Console shows "Rate limited" but API returns `quota_exceeded` code; users get confused.
Elaine: Can we define a canonical mapping? e.g., HTTP 429 -> code: RATE_LIMIT, badge: "Quota", hint: "retry-after" ?
Maria: I'd prefer 3 user-visible buckets: RETRYABLE, SOFT_DEGRADE, TERMINAL. Keep internal subcodes for ops/telemetry.
Ajay: +1. Also add a `client_hint` field in the body for SDKs to surface suggestions (backoff, fallback).
Sam: Example payload:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "code": "RATE_LIMIT",
  "message": "You hit a quota. Try again later.",
  "client_hint": "retry-after:30"
}
```
Elaine: For console: badge colors and copy should map to those buckets. RETRYABLE -> yellow + 'Try again', SOFT_DEGRADE -> orange + 'Partial results', TERMINAL -> red + 'Action required'.
Maria: Telemetry: tag all responses with `exposure_level` (retryable|degrade|terminal) and `route_reason` so we can query DAGs later.
Ajay: How about rollout? We ship messaging code behind a flag and enable for 10% customer traffic, linked to peephole canary.
Sam: We'll need SDK changes: surface `client_hint` in helpers and standardize the Retry-After parsing.
Elaine: Also docs and console copy. Who owns the doc PR?
Maria: I'll open an RFC today. @Ajay can you sketch the HTTP field names and sample SDK contract?
Ajay: Will do by EOD. I'll add examples for JS/Py.
deploy-bot: RFC draft created: https://redwood.internal/rfc/clarity-error-lexicon (auto)
Sam: Also add a telemetry dashboard card: 1) % retryable by route 2) time-to-first-success after retry 3) top subcodes.
Maria: Nice. Next steps: RFC, SDK PR, Console copy PR, Docs, 10% canary. Callout: do not change existing error codes until we have fallback mapping for older SDKs.
Elaine: +1. If anyone wants to be on the review loop for console copy ping me.
Ajay: I'll include telemetry tags in the RFC.
Maria: Thanks team — sync in #eng-platform tomorrow 10am for handoff.
